responsibility: Provides the automaton-based instruction scheduling model for TILEPro. It defines the X and Y pipeline units, issue/bundling exclusions, and reservation/latency classes such as one-cycle, two-cycle, L2, miss, and cannot-bundle forms, giving GCC’s scheduler the machine-resource model used to estimate hazards, bundle legality, and execution timing for instructions whose type attributes are set in tilepro.md.
